posts.author: KiZai
posts.title: Re: Big red Errors
posts.edited: Last Edit: June 17, 2009, 07:47:34 PM by KiZai
posts.html:
The easiest way to get it is from www.glua.net.

Download the PHX 3 package found here:

http://glua.h4xmb.org/~glua/svn/phx.zip

Extract this to your addons folder inside your garrysmod folder, restart garrysmod, profit. It is also important that you have updated CSS and Half Life 2 content installed, as that may be the cause of some errors.

-KiZai
